# Open a File

#### Course: Learn C++ Intermediate

## Open a File

In C++, we use the open() function to open a file.

Suppose we have a file named message.txt with the following content.

![A text file on the computer.](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, let's open this file using the open() function.

```cpp
// create an fstream object
fstream my_file;

// open a file
my_file.open("message.txt");
```

As you can see, we have used the open() function with the my_file object to open the message.txt file.

Opening a file means connecting our program with the file. Now, we can perform different file operations on the message.txt file.
